dataset.name: Swiss performance-related heavy vehicle fee (LSVA / RPLP)
dataset.method: Schwerverkehrsabgabeverordnung (SVAV, SR 641.811) of 27 March 2024, Art. 8 para. 1 as amended 20 September 2024 (AS 2024 522), in force 1 January 2025: 3.26 / 2.82 / 2.39 Rappen per tonne-km for fee categories 1 / 2 / 3; Annex 1: EURO VI in category 3, EURO 0-V in category 1; Art. 6 para. 3: chargeable weight at most 40 t.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: SVAV (SR 641.811), consolidated text as of 1 October 2025, Art. 8 tariff and Annex 1 fee categories
BAZG: LSVA general information and tariffs

vehicles.description: Motor vehicles and trailers over 3.5 t total weight used for goods transport, Swiss or foreign

network.description: All public roads: the fee is per km driven anywhere in Switzerland and Liechtenstein.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.

params.note: Motor vehicles with electric drive are exempt (SVAV Art. 2 para. 1 let. k); the revised Heavy Vehicle Fee Act adopted on 2 October 2026 keeps them exempt until the end of 2030.
